jobs.title: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Manager
jobs.description:
## About RET Deutschland (RET Germany e.V.)

RET Deutschland (RET Germany e.V.) is a Berlin-based non-governmental organisation and part of the RET Alliance. RET works with young people, their families and host communities affected by crisis, displacement and fragility, supporting them through education, economic opportunities and initiatives that strengthen social cohesion and peaceful co-existence.

RET Deutschland has supported Syrian refugees and returnees for over a decade and is now opening a project office in Aleppo for a new multi-year, German-funded project.

## The programme

Starting in January 2027, RET Deutschland will launch a new multi-year, German-funded project in Syria. The project is implemented by **Syrian local partner organisations**: RET Deutschland is responsible for overall project management, coordination, technical quality assurance, MEAL and donor compliance. The project works towards three interlinked outcomes:

- **Education** – improving access to and quality of education for children and young people;
- **Livelihoods (vocational training)** – strengthening economic opportunities and self-reliance for young people and vulnerable households;
- **Social cohesion** – fostering trust, dialogue and peaceful co-existence within and between communities.

Activities will take place in Aleppo and Idlib governorates. Because RET Deutschland works exclusively through its local partners, robust review and quality assurance of partner data, together with strong partner MEAL capacities, are central to ensuring quality, accountability and learning across the project.

## Purpose of the position

The MEAL Manager sets up and oversees a robust, practical and conflict-sensitive MEAL system for RET Deutschland’s project in Syria. As all activities, including routine monitoring and data collection, are carried out by the local partners, the role focuses on **secondary monitoring**: reviewing, verifying and quality-assuring the data and reports provided by the partners, and using them to track progress against the results framework, steer implementation, learn and adapt, and meet donor reporting requirements. The MEAL Manager is **directly responsible for the baseline, mid-term and endline studies**, typically carried out with external consultants under their supervision. The position also helps strengthen the MEAL capacities of the local partners, drafts reports, and contributes to proposal development.

## Key responsibilities

### 1. MEAL system set-up (inception phase)

- Operationalise the project's results matrix: develop indicator reference sheets, a MEAL plan and an indicator tracking table, clearly defining which data the local partners collect, how often, and how RET reviews and verifies it.
- Agree harmonised data collection and reporting tools (digital, e.g. KoboToolbox/ODK) with the local partners, review partners' tools for quality, and set common standards for data protection.
- Set up a common reporting flow and calendar so that partner data feeds smoothly into consolidated project reporting.

### 2. Review and quality assurance of partner monitoring data

- Review and quality-assure the regular monitoring data and progress reports submitted by the local partners against the results framework, and provide timely, constructive feedback.
- Carry out regular data quality assessments and verification visits in Aleppo and Idlib (e.g. spot checks, review of attendance lists and participant records, back-checks with a sample of participants) to triangulate partner-reported data.
- Ensure that participant data is accurate, disaggregated (sex, age, disability, displacement status), free of double counting and handled in line with data protection standards.
- Consolidate partner data into the indicator tracking table and flag deviations, delays or risks to project management.
- Put in place remote verification arrangements where access is restricted for security reasons.
- Monitor contextual changes, risks, conflict sensitivity (Do No Harm) and possible unintended effects, based on partner reporting and own field visits, and feed findings into management decisions.

### 3. Accountability to affected populations

- Ensure that the local partners operate accessible, safe and confidential complaints and feedback mechanisms; regularly review feedback data and check that complaints are followed up and used.
- Check that participants and communities are informed about the project and involved in monitoring and learning processes.
- Support the integration of safeguarding and PSEA principles into all MEAL activities.
- Ensure secure and responsible data management, including appropriate access controls, informed consent, data minimisation, anonymisation and safe storage of personal and sensitive information, in line with RET's data protection policies.

### 4. Baseline, mid-term and endline studies, evaluation and learning

- Lead the planning, design and implementation of (external) baseline, mid-term and endline studies: develop the methodology and sampling strategies, draft terms of reference, coordinate the selection, recruitment and supervision of external consultants and/or enumerator teams, ensure the quality of data collection, and review and approve analysis and reports.
- Finalise baseline, midline and endline values and targets and update the results matrix accordingly.
- Organise regular learning and reflection sessions with the local partners to review progress, discuss findings and adapt activities.
- Document good practices, lessons learned and success stories, including on localisation and partnership.
- Ensure that findings and recommendations from assessments, monitoring activities and evaluations are systematically translated into management decisions and programme adaptations.

### 5. Reporting and proposal development

- Analyse and study partner data and produce regular progress dashboards and briefs for RET project management.
- Draft the results-related sections of interim and final donor reports, consolidating partner reports into clear, high-quality narrative in English, and ensure that reported figures are consistent and verifiable.
- Contribute to proposal development, including context and problem analysis, results frameworks and logframes, indicators, and MEAL sections and budgets.

### 6. Partner capacity strengthening and coordination

- Assess the MEAL capacities of the local partners and, together with them, develop and implement a MEAL capacity-strengthening plan (e.g. training, coaching, joint tool development, on-the-job support during verification visits).
- Support partners in improving their own data collection, data management, analysis and reporting practices.
- Work closely with RET programme, finance and management colleagues in Syria, Gaziantep and Berlin.

## Your profile

### Required

- University degree in social sciences, statistics, development studies, economics or a related field.
- At least 5 years of professional experience in monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning in humanitarian or development programmes, including at least 2 years at manager or coordinator level.
- Proven experience in setting up MEAL systems based on a logframe or results framework, including outcome-level indicators, baselines and evaluations.
- Experience in reviewing and quality-assuring monitoring data from local partner organisations, and in strengthening their MEAL capacities through training and coaching.
- Experience in commissioning and supervising baseline, mid-term or endline studies or evaluations carried out by external consultants.
- Solid knowledge in monitoring and assessing outcome-level results, including the design, implementation and analysis of quantitative and qualitative methods, sampling and survey design.
- Ability to translate findings into clear reports, dashboards and actionable recommendations.
- **Excellent report writing skills** and **proven experience in proposal writing** for institutional donors.
- Good skills in digital data collection tools (KoboToolbox, ODK or similar) and data analysis (advanced Excel; Power BI, SPSS, Stata or R is an advantage).
- **Native-level Arabic and fluency in English** (spoken and written).
- Willingness and ability to be based in Aleppo and to travel frequently to Idlib governorate.
- Ability to work independently and calmly in a volatile and fast-changing operating environment, with strong conflict sensitivity.

### Desirable

- Previous experience in monitoring / evaluating livelihoods projects (in particular vocational training) and/or education projects is strongly preferred.
- Experience with social cohesion or peacebuilding programming.
- Previous work experience in Syria, in particular in Aleppo and/or Idlib.
- Experience with German public donors or other institutional donors.
- Experience with complaints and feedback mechanisms, safeguarding and data protection.

## What we offer

- A key role in setting up a new programme and project office from the start.
- Close collaboration with committed Syrian partner organisations and a supportive international team.
- Salary according to RET's national / international salary scale, depending on qualifications and experience.
- Benefits will be based on RET’s national or international salary and benefit scale, as applicable
- Opportunities for professional development.

jobs.title: Venezuela: Conductor (Caracas)
jobs.description:
La Cruz Roja Venezolana (CRV) es una organización humanitaria cuyo mandato es salvar vidas y mejorar las condiciones de las personas en situación de vulnerabilidad. Como parte del Movimiento Internacional de la Cruz Roja y la Medialuna Roja, brinda asistencia oportuna en emergencias, desastres y contextos de necesidad humanitaria.

Guiada por sus Principios Fundamentales (Humanidad, Imparcialidad, Neutralidad, Independencia, Voluntariado, Unidad y Universalidad) la CRV actúa como auxiliar de los poderes públicos en el ámbito humanitario, trabajando para reducir el sufrimiento humano sin distinción de raza, género, religión o ideología. Su labor abarca la atención médica de emergencia, el fortalecimiento de la resiliencia comunitaria, la capacitación en primeros auxilios, la respuesta a desastres y la promoción de la salud y el bienestar.

A través de una red de voluntarios altamente comprometidos, la CRV moviliza recursos de manera eficiente y eficaz para estar presente donde más se necesita, cuando más se necesita. Su labor se fundamenta en la solidaridad, el respeto a la dignidad humana y el compromiso con la protección de la vida en todas sus formas.

**Compromiso con la Salvaguarda**

La Cruz Roja Venezolana está comprometida con la creación y mantenimiento de entornos seguros y respetuosos para las comunidades, el personal y el voluntariado y con la prevención de la explotación, el abuso y el acoso sexual.

Las personas seleccionadas deberán cumplir el Código de Conducta y las políticas y estándares de Salvaguarda aplicables. Como parte de su proceso de contratación segura, la CRV podrá realizar verificaciones de referencias profesionales y solicitar información pertinente sobre antecedentes de conducta profesional y Salvaguarda, de acuerdo con sus procedimientos y la normativa aplicable.

**Responsabilidad general de Salvaguarda**

La persona titular del puesto deberá promover y respetar los estándares de Salvaguarda de la Cruz Roja Venezolana, cumplir el Código de Conducta y las políticas aplicables, mantener límites profesionales apropiados, contribuir a prevenir daños y reportar de forma inmediata cualquier preocupación de Salvaguarda a través de los mecanismos establecidos.

**Adición para puestos de riesgo elevado**

Debido a la naturaleza de sus funciones, la persona deberá identificar y mitigar activamente riesgos de Salvaguarda asociados a sus actividades, mantener estándares reforzados de conducta y límites profesionales y asegurar que su interacción con comunidades y personas en situación de vulnerabilidad se desarrolle de forma segura, digna, inclusiva y respetuosa.

Si deseas formar parte del equipo y hacer la diferencia, te invitamos a sumarte.

¿Cómo puedes hacer la diferencia? Funciones claves / Responsabilidades

El/La Conductor/a apoyará las actividades de salud, preparación para desastres y respuesta a emergencias mediante el traslado seguro y oportuno del personal y los recursos asignados. Conducirá los vehículos autorizados de acuerdo con la planificación de cada actividad, las normas de tránsito y los procedimientos de la Cruz Roja Venezolana.

Será responsable de completar las bitácoras de uso y mantener actualizada la documentación de los vehículos bajo su responsabilidad, incluidas sus hojas de vida y los registros de mantenimiento. Realizará las revisiones preventivas que correspondan al conductor, dará seguimiento a los mantenimientos programados y reportará de inmediato cualquier falla, daño o incidente. También velará por el buen uso, la limpieza y las condiciones de seguridad de los vehículos, conforme a los procedimientos de la Cruz Roja Venezolana y los lineamientos de la Cruz Roja Alemana.

Será el/la encargado(a) de:

· Conducir los vehículos asignados para el traslado seguro y oportuno del personal, equipos y suministros durante las actividades de salud, preparación para desastres y respuesta a emergencias, de acuerdo con las movilizaciones autorizadas.

· Participar, junto con el equipo responsable, en la evaluación previa de las misiones, aportando información sobre las rutas, el estado de las vías, los tiempos de desplazamiento y las condiciones que puedan afectar el acceso seguro.

· Coordinar con el equipo responsable los horarios, destinos y rutas de las movilizaciones autorizadas, e informar oportunamente cualquier retraso o cambio que afecte el traslado.

· Cumplir las normas de tránsito, los procedimientos institucionales de seguridad vial y las indicaciones de seguridad establecidas para cada misión. Reportar cualquier cambio en las condiciones de acceso observado durante el trayecto.

· Verificar antes de cada salida las condiciones básicas del vehículo, incluidos neumáticos, luces, frenos, niveles de fluidos, combustible y elementos de seguridad. Informar cualquier condición que impida su uso seguro.

· Mantener actualizadas las bitácoras de los vehículos, registrando fechas, recorridos, kilometraje, consumo de combustible, usuarios y novedades de cada movilización.

· Mantener organizadas y actualizadas las hojas de vida de los vehículos, incluidos los registros de mantenimiento, reparaciones, inspecciones y demás documentos relacionados con su operación.

· Dar seguimiento a los mantenimientos preventivos programados e informar oportunamente las necesidades de mantenimiento correctivo. Trasladar el vehículo al taller cuando sea autorizado.

· Verificar que la documentación obligatoria del vehículo y la licencia de conducir se encuentren vigentes, e informar con anticipación sobre sus fechas de vencimiento.

· Mantener los vehículos limpios, en buen estado de uso y con los elementos de seguridad requeridos (incluido el botiquín de primeros auxilios). Informar sobre daños, faltantes o necesidades de reposición.

· Resguardar el vehículo, sus llaves y documentos durante el tiempo en que estén bajo su responsabilidad, siguiendo los procedimientos institucionales.

· Reportar de inmediato accidentes de tránsito, fallas mecánicas, incidentes de seguridad, daños o cualquier otra novedad ocurrida durante el uso del vehículo, y completar los registros correspondientes.

· Cumplir los procedimientos de gestión de flota y seguridad de la Cruz Roja Venezolana, los lineamientos aplicables de la Cruz Roja Alemana y las disposiciones de los proyectos en los que participe.

· Realizar otras tareas relacionadas directamente con la conducción y el cuidado de los vehículos asignados, según las necesidades operativas.

Reporte

El/La Conductor y alistamiento reportará al Oficial de Logística.

Lugar de trabajo

Caracas, con disponibilidad para viajar a los sitios de implementación de proyecto.

Para calificar como un constructor del sistema humanitario venezolano deberás cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:

· Bachiller o técnico medio. Se valorará formación complementaria en conducción segura, seguridad vial, primeros auxilios o áreas afines.

· Licencia de conducir vigente y adecuada para el tipo de vehículo que se le asigne.

· Mínimo dos (2) años de experiencia en conducción de vehículos. Se valorará la experiencia con unidades móviles o en operaciones humanitarias y de emergencia.

· Conocimientos básicos de revisión preventiva de vehículos, identificación de fallas y seguimiento de necesidades de mantenimiento.

· Experiencia en el manejo de bitácoras, registros de kilometraje, consumo de combustible y documentación de vehículos.

· Conocimiento de las normas de tránsito y capacidad para conducir de forma segura en vías urbanas y rurales.

· Capacidad para identificar y comunicar condiciones de las rutas que puedan afectar el desplazamiento o el acceso seguro de las misiones.

· Manejo básico de herramientas informáticas o aplicaciones para registrar movilizaciones y reportar novedades.

· Disponibilidad para desplazarse y trabajar en terreno, incluidos horarios extendidos o fines de semana cuando las necesidades operativas lo requieran.

· Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, seguir instrucciones y cumplir los procedimientos de seguridad y gestión de flota.

· Experiencia en contextos de emergencia, operativos de salud o trabajo con voluntariado (deseable).

· Experiencia con el Movimiento Internacional de la Cruz Roja y de la Medialuna Roja (deseable).

· Compromiso con los Principios Fundamentales de la Cruz Roja y de la Medialuna Roja.

· Fluidez oral y escrita en español.

jobs.title: Terms of Reference for External Statutory Audit for Year 2026
jobs.description:
**I. Organisation Background**

Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe was founded in 1952, and is represented by 9 national and round 300 regional and local associations throughout the Federal Republic of Germany. Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe is a chapter of the Johanniter Order and a registered association in accordance with German legislature. Besides domestic obligations (like Emergency Medical Services, Civil Protection, and social services) the statutory duties and responsibilities of Johanniter also include international humanitarian assistance.

In its international humanitarian work, Johanniter is committed to act responsible and fair. Together with donors, colleagues and project partners, we approach different cultures and populations with respect, integrity and commitment. Our highest priority is to act according to the needs of the most vulnerable people. We mainly focus on three areas of work: primary health care, disaster response and preparedness, and rehabilitation of people with disability. Sustainability is of particular importance to us: We aim to improve the living conditions of people in distress in the short, mid and long term. To this end, we use our resources carefully and with foresight and we consider the social, economic and ecological consequences of our assistance. We are committed to the principles of accountability and transparency towards our donors and partners. We continually assess whether our structures and processes can be improved. Our consistent quality standards as well as regular monitoring and controlling ensure the professionalism of our work and make it verifiable. For more information about Johanniter consult [www.thejohanniter.de](http://www.thejohanniter.de).

Johanniter Unfall Hilfe has been in operation in Kenya since year 2011.

The main values and principles underlying the work of the Johanniter International Assistance are laid down in the “Mission Statement”. All staff members working for Johanniter International Assistance are expected to act in line with the mission statement. Details about the organizational structure of the Johanniter office in Kenya are laid down in the organogram.

**II. Project to be covered by Audit**

All projects which were running/open during the period of 01 January 2026 to 31st December 2026.

**III. Description of Financial Reports to be audited**

The report to be audited is referred to as the Expenditure Utilization Report of Budget vs. Actual, Income and Expenditure Statement with narratives. These reports are prepared by the organization using MS Excel or any other appropriate accounting software.

**IV. Audit Services Required**

- The audit firm will conduct an audit of the Johanniter Kenya operations for the year 2026.
- The audit will be carried out in accordance with either International Auditing Standards
- The audit timeframe/period is from 01.01.2026 to 31.12.2026
- The sample of vouchers checked should cover a minimum of 30% of the total transaction value
- The audit should ensure that all categories of costs are included in the sample such as a) Procurements, b) Staffing costs, c) travel costs, training costs etc.
- The Scope of the audit is to be covered as follows:
- The audit will be carried out in accordance with the International Auditing Standards and will include tests and verification procedures as the auditors deem necessary;
- Verify that funds have been used in accordance with the established policies and procedures of Johanniter.
- That goods and services financed have been procured in accordance with the Johanniter established policies and procedures;
- That appropriate supporting documents, records and books of accounts relating to all activities have been kept;
- That the financial statements have been prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standards and give a true and fair view of the financial position of Johanniter and of its receipts and expenditures for the period ended on that date;
- Comprehensive assessment of the adequacy and effectiveness of the accounting and overall internal control system to monitor expenditures and other financial transactions.
- To determine whether the financial management capacity and financial systems and internal control mechanisms within the organization are adequate to manage the funds provided to the program;
- Include in their reports opinion on compliance with procedures designed to provide reasonable assurance of detecting misstatements due to errors or fraud that are material in the financial statements.
- Determine the compliance with the existing country/statutory/taxation regulations as regards maintenance of financial statements
- Conduct entry and exit meeting with the Kenya Johanniter International Assistance management
- To produce an indipendent auditor’s report which expresses an opinion on the financial statements with regards to the financial position as at 31 December 2025 and its financial performance and cash flows for the year then ended as presenting faily in all material respects.
- **Audit Approach**

The auditors’ work should include but not limited to sufficient tests to establish whether:

- Johanniter Kenya has adequate accounting and financial operations and reporting systems.
- An adequate budgetary control system is in place to monitor actual expenditure against budget and to take effective remedial action as necessary, with adequate segregation of duties in the maintenance and review of accounts and the performance of reconciliations
- Goods and services have been procured in accordance with the relevant organisational policies and procedures;
- Inventories and assets registers are complete and accurate;
- All necessary supporting documents, records, and accounts have been kept in respect of all project ventures;
- Expenditure of funds has been approved at the correct level of delegated authority. This includes initial approval to incur expenditure and the payment of claims, invoices, salaries, allowances and any other items of expenditure charges to the project budget;
- Records of transactions include accurate information regarding any variations in currency exchange rates, where relevant

**V. The Audit Report and Management Letter**

***Audit Report***
- The Auditors on completion of the audit work will submit 5 (five) original copies of the Audit Report appended to the Financial Statements along with the reports to JUH Head of Mission
- Management letter in accordance with the scope of work described above

***Management Letter***
- The management letter should cover the following topics/issues:
- Give comments and observations on the accounting records, systems and controls that were examined during the course of the audit
- Identify specific deficiencies and areas of weakness in systems and controls and make recommendations for their improvement
- Report on the degree of compliance with the financing agreement and give comments, if any, on the internal and external matters affecting such compliance
- Give an opinion on the potential for fraud and corruption in implementation of the project, and provide details of any actual fraud or corruption incidents during the period under review and the value of possible losses

***Audit Certificate***
- A copy of Audit Certificate of the audit firm appointed as to ensure professional accreditation.

**VI. Application and Selection Process:**

Interested consultants/firms are invited to submit the following mandatory documents. Please note that if any of the required documents are missing from your submission, your application will not be considered.

1. Cover letter- with the name, position, phone number, email and address of the company
2. Full Technical proposal. This includes a brief of your understanding of the assignment, methodology, work plan, team composition.
3. Financial proposal (Inclusive of all applicable taxes and reimbursements)
4. CV of all proposed team members
5. Legal Company Registration Certificate
6. Certificate of registration with the relevant Institute of Certified Public Accountant
7. KRA PIN Certificate
8. Valid Tax Compliance Certificate
9. Details of 5 similar assignment conducted by the audit firm (from year 2020 onwards)
10. Signed copy of Supplier Declaration Form - with signature & stamp (see Annex).

All application to be sent to Johanniter-Kenya Country office via email address: **procurement.ken@thejohanniter.org**. All queries regarding to this TOR to be directed to the same email address.

**The deadline for applications is 5:00 pm on Wednesday 9th, December 2026.** Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

**Johanniter Safeguarding statement and / or commitment**
It is Johanniter’s responsibility to create an environment built on integrity, respect and accountability, in which all staff and volunteers are comfortable to work and feel safe. We have a zero-tolerance policy when people cause harm to others. Those who misbehave or are complicit will be held accountable for harmful actions. It is the employee’s responsibility to promote appropriate behaviour and to report infringements that could potentially harm those in our organisation’s care and damage the reputation of Johanniter. Those who raise complaints or concerns will be appropriately protected and respected.

**VII. Annexes**

- **Annex 1:** Declaration of Supplier Form

7. we have not been the subject of a judgment which has the force of res judicata for fraud, corruption, involvement in a criminal organisation or any other illegal activity detrimental to Johanniter’s financial interests;
8. following another procurement procedure carried out by Johanniter or another contracting authority, we have not been declared to be in serious breach of contract for failure to comply with our contractual obligations;
9. we are not subject to a conflict of interest with regard to this tender. We declare that the price on the bid attached is a market competitive offer from my organization, and we are submitting to this procurement process without any conflict of interest, or the provision / receipt of any commission, gift, bribe, gratuity or remuneration of any kind.

12. we do not offer, give, receive or solicit, directly or indirectly, or attempt to offer, give, receive or solicit, directly or indirectly, anything of value to improperly influence the actions of JOHANNITER and/or any other party (“Corrupt Practice”);

16. we do not engage in acts that directly support or advance trafficking in persons, including the following acts:

- failing to provide return transportation or pay for return transportation costs to an employee from a country to the country from which the employee was recruited upon the end of employment if requested by the employee.
- soliciting a person for the purpose of employment, or offering employment, by means of materially false or fraudulent pretences, representations, or promises regarding that employment.
17. we do respect applicable law relating to anti-money laundering in the execution of our contracts.

**General statements:**

- The contractor shall communicate these fundamentals of JOHANNITER’s Policy to its management, employees, subcontractors and agents and shall take all reasonable measures to ensure that such persons do not engage in prohibited practices.
- The contractor shall immediately disclose to JOHANNITER any actual, apparent, potential or attempted prohibited practice that the contractor becomes aware of. To that end, the contractor shall fully cooperate, and shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that its management, employees, subcontractors and agents fully cooperate with any investigation of prohibited practices by JOHANNITER, including by complying with all reasonable requests from JOHANNITER to gain access to and inspect any records, documents and other relevant information.
- JOHANNITER is committed to the protection of vulnerable populations in humanitarian crisis, including from sexual exploitation and abuse. By entering into a contract with JOHANNITER, The contractor undertakes to ensure that its personnel, agents and subcontractors conform to the highest standards of moral and ethical conduct.

The contractor expressly acknowledges and agrees that:

- Any breach of this policy by the contractor or by any of its management, employees, subcontractors or agents constitutes a material breach of the contracts, which entitles JOHANNITER to immediately terminate a contract without incurring any liability to the contractor; and
- In the event that JOHANNITER were to determine through an investigation or otherwise that a prohibited practice occurred, JOHANNITER shall have, in addition to its right to immediately terminate the contract, the rights to:
- apply and enforce the relevant sanctions in accordance with its internal regulations, rules, procedures, practices, policies and guidelines, including referral of the matter to national authorities when appropriate; and
- recover all losses, financial or otherwise, suffered by JOHANNITER in connection with such prohibited practices.

jobs.title: إعلان استقطاب مدرب/ة تدريب التواصل الآمن والمسؤولية عن البيانات
jobs.description:
## إعلان استقطاب مدرب/ة

### تدريب التواصل الآمن والمسؤولية عن البيانات

**Safe Communications & Minimum Data Responsibility**

**الجهة المنفذة:** منظمة ماري للبحث والتنمية (MRD)
**المشروع:** مبادرة جاهزية المجتمع المدني للمستقبل (FRCSI)
**مكان التنفيذ:** دمشق – سوريا
**مدة التدريب:** يومان تدريبيان
**موعد التنفيذ المتوقع:** النصف الثاني من شهر كانون الأول/ديسمبر 2026
**آخر موعد للتقديم:** 3 كانون الأول/ديسمبر 2026

تعمل منظمة ماري للبحث والتنمية (MRD) على تنفيذ مشروع «مبادرة جاهزية المجتمع المدني للمستقبل» (FRCSI)، والذي يهدف إلى تعزيز القدرات المؤسسية والاستدامة والجاهزية لدى منظمات المجتمع المدني السورية.

وفي إطار أنشطة بناء القدرات ضمن المشروع، تعلن المنظمة عن رغبتها في استقطاب مدرب/ة أو خبير/ة متخصص/ة لتصميم وتنفيذ تدريب حول التواصل الآمن والمسؤولية عن البيانات، يستهدف ممثلي منظمات المجتمع المدني المشاركة في المشروع.

#### 2. الهدف من التدريب

يهدف التدريب إلى تعزيز معرفة ومهارات المشاركين في مجال التواصل المؤسسي الآمن وإدارة البيانات والمعلومات بصورة مسؤولة، بما يضمن حماية الخصوصية والسرية، وتقليل مخاطر تداول المعلومات، وتحسين ممارسات التواصل مع الموظفين والشركاء والمجتمعات المستهدفة.

#### 3. المحاور التدريبية المقترحة

ينبغي أن يغطي التدريب، على سبيل المثال لا الحصر، المحاور التالية:

- مبادئ وممارسات التواصل الآمن داخل المنظمات ومع الشركاء.
- المسؤولية عن البيانات ومبادئ تقليل جمع المعلومات (Data Minimization).
- الموافقة المستنيرة وحماية الخصوصية والسرية.
- مشاركة الملفات والمعلومات وتخزينها بطرق آمنة.
- تحديد مخاطر تسريب البيانات والمعلومات وإجراءات الحد منها.
- الظهور الإعلامي المسؤول وحماية المعلومات الحساسة.
- تطوير الرسائل المؤسسية والتواصل مع الجمهور وأصحاب المصلحة.
- أساليب التواصل والمناصرة المسؤولة.

#### 4. نطاق العمل والمسؤوليات

يتولى المدرب/ة المختار/ة المهام التالية:

- مراجعة أهداف المشروع والاطلاع على الاحتياجات المؤسسية للمنظمات المشاركة.
- إعداد أجندة تدريبية تفصيلية لمدة يومين.
- تصميم المنهجية التدريبية وإعداد المواد العلمية باللغة العربية.
- إعداد التمارين والتطبيقات العملية المناسبة لطبيعة المنظمات المشاركة.
- تنفيذ التدريب حضوريًا في مدينة دمشق.
- تقديم تقرير موجز عن التدريب يتضمن الأنشطة المنفذة والمخرجات والملاحظات والتوصيات.

#### 5. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة

- شهادة جامعية في الاتصالات أو إدارة المعلومات أو أمن المعلومات أو حماية البيانات أو أي مجال ذي صلة.
- خبرة عملية مثبتة في التواصل الآمن وإدارة البيانات والمعلومات بصورة مسؤولة.
- خبرة سابقة في تصميم وتنفيذ التدريبات للمنظمات غير الحكومية ومنظمات المجتمع المدني.
- معرفة جيدة بمبادئ حماية البيانات والخصوصية والسرية والموافقة المستنيرة وممارسات مشاركة المعلومات الآمنة.
- امتلاك مهارات تيسير وتدريب وتواصل ممتازة باللغة العربية.
- تُعد الخبرة السابقة في العمل مع منظمات المجتمع المدني السورية ميزة إضافية.

#### 6. متطلبات التقديم

على الراغبين بالتقدم تقديم الوثائق التالية:

**أولًا: العرض الفني (Technical Proposal)**

- فهم نطاق المهمة وأهداف التدريب.
- المنهجية والأساليب التدريبية المقترحة.
- أجندة تفصيلية للتدريب على مدى يومين.
- تصور للمحتوى العلمي والتمارين والتطبيقات العملية.
- السيرة الذاتية المحدثة، مع إبراز الخبرات ذات الصلة.

**ثانيًا: العرض المالي (Financial Proposal)**

- عرض مالي مفصل لتنفيذ المهمة التدريبية كاملة على مدى يومين.
- توضيح أتعاب التدريب وأي تكاليف إضافية ذات صلة.
- إجمالي التكلفة المقترحة لتنفيذ المهمة.

## إعلان استقطاب مدرب/ة

**مدة التدريب:** يومان تدريبيان

#### 6. متطلبات التقديم

jobs.title: Warehouse Officer_ Maiduguri
jobs.description:
**Key responsibilities**

- Plan and follow on a day-to-day basis the Warehouse and Stock Management activities in the project or capital, ensuring compliance with INTERSOS standards, protocols and procedures. These activities include but are not limited to the following activities:
- physically and administratively managing non-medical and medical stocks in collaboration with the Country Supply Manager and the stock owners and assuming responsibility for the warehouse and its contents
- ensure that all necessary tools and management procedures are in place to avoid stock ruptures, losses (expiries, damages due to bad storage conditions, temperature breach) and excess stocks. Regularly check inventory levels (physical counts), keeping inventories up to date and monitoring consumption. Monitor cold chain
- ensure that data reported in INTERSOS Inventory Management System (IMS) are correctly used and accurate. Is responsible for both digital and physical archives of administrative documents
- checking, recording and arranging the goods received and ensuring the availability of a wide range of items for various projects and departments (medical supplies, food, spare parts, tools, equipment, etc.)
- ensure that all items are well organized and correctly stored according to their specificity, well protected, fully identified and easily accessible (cleanliness, security, access, etc.)
- Supervise the team under his responsibility including the definition and planning of each person's tasks (daily supervision and checking the quality of their work); draw up a working schedule and organize and lead team meetings
- Supervise, in close coordination with the HR department, the associated processes (recruitment, training/induction, evaluation, potential detection, development and communication) of the staff under his responsibility to ensure both the sizing and the amount of knowledge required
- Perform delegated tasks according to his specialty and as specified in his job description

**Essential requirements:**

**Education**

**Minimum / Entry-Level:HND** (Higher National Diploma) or **bachelor’s degree (BSc/BA)** in Logistics & Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Purchasing & Supply, Accounting, Economics, or a closely related field Professional experience.

**Professional requirements**

**2–4 years** of practical experience in warehouse management, stock/inventory control, or supply chain operations—ideally with an INGO, UN agency, or structured commercial/logistics operation.

- Basic mathematics and use of measuring equipment
- Essential computer literacy (word, excel and internet)

**Personal requirements**

- Service orientation
- Behavioural flexibility
- Results and quality orientation
- Teamwork and cooperation
- Stress Management
- Commitment to INTERSOS principles

**Languages**

- Proficiency in English(written and spoken)

Knowledge and fluency in English and local languages (Hausa and Kanuri) will be an asset

jobs.title: Project Manager Burundi
jobs.description:
**INTRODUCTION**

The Belgian Red Cross-Flanders (Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen, RKV) is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. Adherence to the seven Fundamental Principles – Humanity, Impartiality, Neutrality, Independence, Voluntary Service, Unity, and Universality – is at the core of all our actions. In close collaboration with the local Red Cross Society in each country and its many volunteers, RKV, as a sister National Society, focuses on implementing projects related to first aid, blood donor recruitment and services, and emergency response, primarily in Africa.

In the coming years, RKV will further strengthen its expertise-driven strategy to maximize the impact of its in-house expertise and operations in humanitarian contexts where needs are particularly high. Professionalism, integrity, initiative, and teamwork are essential core values within the organization.

RKV is seeking a **Project Manager in Burundi** who will also serve as **Country Representative** and manage the ongoing partnership with Burundi Red Cross with a particular focus on first aid, blood services, and emergency disaster response.

**POSITION**

The Project Manager represents the Belgian Red Cross-Flanders (RKV) with Burundi Red Cross, donors, and other humanitarian actors in the country. You will report directly to one of RKV’s Regional Managers, who in turn reports to the Head of International Cooperation at headquarters.

You will ensure the effective management of projects related to First Aid, blood services, and emergency disaster response, implemented by Burundi RC with financial and technical support from RKV.

RKV relies on your skills in project planning and communication, detailed financial monitoring, and stakeholder management. Overall accountability as Project Manager is a critical success factor.

**Key Responsibilities**

This position combines the **operational, financial, strategic, and representational management** of the Belgian Red Cross-Flanders’ portfolio and presence in Burundi.

- **Project Management:** Ensure the timely and high-quality implementation of projects, support the Burundi Red Cross in the day-to-day management of activities, and ensure compliance with procedures, policies, and strategic objectives.
- **Financial and Budget Management:** Oversee budget planning and monitoring, ensure accurate financial forecasting and expenditure tracking, conduct quality control of supporting documentation, and guarantee timely and compliant financial reporting to headquarters and donors.
- **Reporting and Communication:** Provide clear and concise reporting on programme progress, proactively identify and resolve challenges, and maintain transparent communication with headquarters and key stakeholders.
- **Resource Mobilization:** Develop high-quality project proposals, monitor national and international funding opportunities, and actively identify opportunities for funding and technical cooperation.
- **Stakeholder Management and Representation:** Build and maintain strong partnerships with Burundi Red Cross, represent Belgian Red Cross-Flanders within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, and engage effectively with government authorities, donors, embassies, NGOs, and other external stakeholders.
- **Country Representation and Delegation Management:** Lead the overall management of the Belgian Red Cross-Flanders delegation in Burundi, strengthen institutional partnerships, oversee security management, and coordinate responses to security incidents.
- **Integrity and Compliance:** Ensure the effective implementation of the organization’s integrity framework, promote accountability and good governance practices, and support the management and investigation of integrity-related incidents when required.

You may be involved in managing small strategic projects outside your primary country of assignment.

**PROFILE**

- You hold a university Master’s degree in science, economics, management, international development, or a related field.
- Knowledge of medical sciences, first aid, blood banking, and/or data management is considered an asset. At a minimum, you have a strong interest in these areas and are willing to develop your expertise and act as a knowledgeable ambassador for the organization.
- You have at least 5 years of experience in project management.
- Experience in a results-oriented environment is an advantage.
- Prior international experience in development cooperation or humanitarian aid is a plus
- You combine strong analytical skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and enjoy turning challenges into opportunities.
- You are motivated by the prospect of making a lasting contribution to RKV’s humanitarian mission and shaping its long-term impact.
- Fluency in spoken and written French, English, and Dutch is essential.

**OUR OFFER**

- A demanding yet highly rewarding international experience based in **Bujumbura, Burundi**
- A unique opportunity to strengthen the RKV delegation and support the long-standing partnership with Burundi Red Cross
- Employment within a humanitarian organization that is evidence-based and values scientific expertise as a core principle.
- A role that offers autonomy, encourages initiative and entrepreneurial mindset
- A competitive salary package, including housing and transportation facilities
- An open-ended employment contract.
- A challenging position within an enthusiastic team committed to growth and innovation.

jobs.title: Responsable des Finances - RDC
jobs.description:
INTERSOS est une Organisation Humanitaire Non Gouvernementale, à but non lucratif, qui a pour objectif d’assister les victimes de désastres naturels et de conflits armés. INTERSOS base son action sur les valeurs de la solidarité, de la justice, de la dignité humaine, de l’égalité des droits et des opportunités pour tous les peuples, du respect des diversités, de la cohabitation, de l’attention aux groupes sociaux les plus vulnérables.

## **TERMES DE RÉFÉRENCE**

- **Intitulé du poste :** Responsable des Finances
- **Code :** SR-38-10339
- **Pays :** RDC (République démocratique du Congo)
- **Lieu d’affectation :** BUNIA avec des missions sur le terrain
- **Date de prise de fonction :** 01/03/2027
- **Durée du contrat :** 6 mois
- **Sous la supervision de :** Coordinateur des finances
- **Personnes à charge :** staff finances
- **Type de lieu d’affectation :** Non-family duty station

## **DESCRIPTION GÉNÉRALE DU CONTEXTE**

La situation humanitaire en RDC reste complexe et s'est globalement détériorée ces dernières années, constituée de multiples crises qui se chevauchent, en particulier dans les provinces de l'Est du pays, qui font face à une violence endémique et à des conflits armés. L'insécurité a entraîné des déplacements massifs et répétés, **auxquels s'ajoute une vulnérabilité sanitaire chronique marquée par des épidémies récurrentes, notamment celle de la maladie à virus Ebola.** L'impact de la violence sur les civils est une souffrance majeure avec des violations régulières des droits de l'homme et du droit international humanitaire, y compris des attaques ciblées contre des civils et une forte prévalence de la violence sexiste.

INTERSOS est présent en RDC depuis 2010 et travaille actuellement en Ituri, Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu à travers des programmes de protection, de santé, Wash et sécurité alimentaire en partenariat avec les agences UN et avec des fonds donnés par ECHO, AICS, SV et autres bailleurs.

## **OBJECTIF GÉNÉRAL DE LA POSITION**

Gérer et superviser la gestion économique et financière de la mission (comptabilité, trésorerie, procédures d'audit, etc.) dans le respect des obligations légales et des normes et protocoles INTERSOS afin de fournir une information de qualité, fiable et transparente sur l'utilisation et l'allocation des ressources de la mission.

## **PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS ET TÂCHES**

**Comptabilité et budget**

- Dans le cas où il n'y a pas de responsable comptable dans la mission, est responsable de la qualité et de la comptabilité en temps opportun pour l'ensemble de la mission, par exemple les procédures de trésorerie, les transactions des comptes bancaires, les reçus et les documents administratifs et financiers à l'appui, la saisie électronique des données, la consolidation de la comptabilité globale de la mission, les subventions, le processus de clôture mensuelle, le rapprochement bancaire et les documents, en veillant au strict respect des délais et à la conformité aux directives d'INTERSOS et des bailleurs de fonds, Normes et procédures financières
- Est la référence technique pour toute question liée à la gestion financière : budgétisation, allocation des coûts directs et indirects, reporting financier des bailleurs de fonds, conformité fiscale, audit annuel légal et audit des bailleurs de fonds.
- En collaboration avec le coordinateur financier, soutient la préparation du budget annuel de la mission conformément aux prévisions financières et économiques et aux exigences applicables d'INTERSOS (protocoles, lignes directrices, SoP...), en assurant la collaboration
- Soutenir le chef de projet / programme dans la préparation de la prolongation sans frais et de la révision du budget
- Superviser le niveau de liquidité de la mission (trésorerie et banque) et signaler rapidement les écarts dans le livre de caisse au coordonnateur des finances pays

**Conformité**

- Est chargé d'appuyer le Coordonnateur des finances pays dans le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance économiques et financiers de la mission.
- Est responsable de la gestion financière des contrats avec les bailleurs de fonds, de la préparation et de la vérification de l'adéquation des informations et de la documentation des rapports financiers (intermédiaires et définitifs), ainsi que du suivi et de l'analyse des besoins en matière d'amendements. S'assurer que les exigences en matière de rapports sont respectées.
- Évaluer la pertinence des pièces justificatives pour l'audit (interne et externe).
- Dans le cas où l'organigramme ne prévoit pas le responsable comptable, coordonner et superviser la conduite des audits locaux relatifs à la comptabilité, à la fiscalité, à la main-d'œuvre, à la gestion des stocks et des actifs.
- Garantissez la bonne répartition des coûts sur les subventions en utilisant les modèles pertinents des protocoles.

**Liquidité**

- Vérifier le déblocage des versements conformément au Contrat et faire le suivi en cas de retard
- Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de projets et de programmes à la mise à jour du plan financier.

**Administration**

- Traiter le paiement en garantissant le transfert mensuel en temps opportun des salaires du personnel
- Superviser et traiter le paiement des dettes fiscales et de la sécurité sociale
- Superviser l'archivage des pièces justificatives et la réception des copies papier au niveau du bureau pays

**Gestion du personnel**

- Chargé de s'assurer de l'adéquation en termes d'attitude et de compétence du personnel placé sous sa supervision, en garantissant la bonne application et l'efficacité des processus dans lesquels il est impliqué.

## **PROFIL REQUIS**

### **Éducation**

- Diplôme souhaitable en comptabilité, en finance ou en administration des affaires

### **Expérience professionnelle**

- Minimum de trois ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans des postes financiers, de préférence au sein d'ONG internationales.

### **Exigences professionnelles**

- Formation et expérience solides en comptabilité - qualification professionnelle en comptabilité
- Connaissances essentielles en informatique (Word, Excel, Finance DB et Internet)
- Une expérience antérieure avec des donateurs de l'ONU est souhaitable

### **Langues**

- Français essentiel
- Anglais souhaitable
- Langue de travail locale souhaitable

### **Exigences personnelles**

- Gestion et perfectionnement du personnel
- Orientation vers le service
- Orientation vers les résultats et la qualité
- Flexibilité comportementale
- Engagement en faveur d'INTERSOS et des principes humanitaires

## **CONDITIONS GÉNÉRALES ET AVANTAGES**

- **Fourchette de salaire :** 09 - 3.172€ - 3.577€ monthly gross
- **Hébergement :** Guesthouse partagée
- **R&R :** Le personnel d'INTERSOS appelé à travailler pendant des périodes prolongées dans des lieux d'affectation caractérisés par des conditions dangereuses, stressantes et difficiles bénéficie d'une période régulière et obligatoire de repos et de récupération (Rest and Recuperation – R&R). Cette mesure vise à protéger leur santé et leur bien-être ainsi qu'à garantir une performance professionnelle optimale dès la reprise de leurs fonctions, tout en préservant la capacité opérationnelle de l'Organisation. Les avantages liés au R&R ne constituent pas une compensation financière pour le degré de pénibilité et d'insécurité d'un lieu d'affectation.
Éligibilité : les membres du personnel recrutés en tant que personnel international de terrain dont le contrat mentionne un lieu d'affectation ouvrant droit au R&R comme lieu d'affectation principal, et dont la durée du contrat est égale ou supérieure à 4 mois calendaires.
R&R : 7 jours de récupération psychophysique toutes les 12 semaines + une indemnité de 1 000 €.
- **Rémunération :** la rémunération mensuelle pour chaque poste est définie conformément à la grille salariale et à la grille de fonctions standard internationale d'INTERSOS, en tenant compte de l'expérience du candidat sélectionné. Elle est communiquée lors de l'entretien avec les ressources humaines, ou en tout état de cause lors de la première étape du processus de sélection.
- **Transport :** vols A/R pour l'humanitaire. Pour toute mission d'une durée d'au moins 9 mois, un billet d'avion supplémentaire vers le pays de résidence et le retour sur le lieu de mission sont pris en charge par l'Organisation pour le travailleur humanitaire.
- **Assurance médicale :** assurance accidents et décès ; assurance responsabilité civile ; remboursement des vaccins, du certificat médical et du test PCR pour le déploiement ; soutien psychosocial sur demande pour le travailleur humanitaire.
- **Visa :** INTERSOS prend en charge les frais et l'assistance pour l'obtention du visa pour le travailleur humanitaire.
- **Congés annuels :** 2,5 jours par mois.
- **Formation d’intégration :** cours d'orientation en ligne : chaque nouveau membre du personnel reçoit une formation préparatoire avant le départ, adéquate pour fournir les informations nécessaires relatives à la structure d'INTERSOS et aux principaux processus décisionnels et outils de travail, afin de faciliter son intégration au sein de l'Organisation.
- **Remarque 1 :** INTERSOS applique une « politique d'apprentissage et de développement » (Learning & Development Policy) qui inclut la possibilité de bénéficier de formations et de participer à des formations internes et externes. La priorité sera accordée au personnel travaillant pour INTERSOS depuis plus de deux ans.
- **Remarque 2 :** la classification des lieux d'affectation avec accompagnement, R&R et sans accompagnement est soumise à des critères de sécurité, d'accès aux services de santé et d'éducation, et n'est pas négociable.

jobs.title: REFERENT.E GENRE, DIVERSITE, INCLUSION ET PROTECTION - FRANCE
jobs.description:
About : Action contre la Faim

Créée en 1979, Action contre la Faim est une organisation non gouvernementale internationale qui lutte contre la faim dans le monde. Sa charte des principes humanitaires - indépendance, neutralité, non-discrimination, accès libre et direct aux victimes, professionnalisme, transparence - fonde son identité depuis 45 ans. Sa mission est de sauver des vies en éliminant la faim par la prévention, la détection et le traitement de la sous-nutrition, en particulier pendant et après les situations d'urgence liées aux conflits et aux catastrophes naturelles. Action contre la Faim coordonne ses programmes autour de 7 domaines d'activités : Nutrition et Santé - Santé Mentale, Soutien Psychosocial - Sécurité Alimentaire et Moyens d'Existence - Eau, Assainissement et Hygiène - Plaidoyer - Climat - Recherche. En 2024, Action contre la Faim est venue en aide à plus de 26 millions de personnes dans 57 pays à travers le monde. www.actioncontrelafaim.org

Mission :

Sous la supervision de la Responsable du service Genre et Protection, vos principales missions seront de :

Contribuer au développement et à la mise en oeuvre des stratégies Genre, Diversité, Inclusion et Protection dans les Bureaux Pays et au siège d'ACF France

Vous avez une expérience avérée de prise en compte de la dimension de genre et protection dans le cycle de projets.

La maitrise du français et de l'anglais tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit sera indispensable.

jobs.title: Program Officer-Business Developmenet
jobs.description:
Danish Refugee Council, one of the world’s leading humanitarian NGOs, is currently looking for a highly qualified Program Officer-Business Development.

**About the job**

To strengthen DRC Somalia’s funding pipeline and donor partnerships through proactive donor engagement, market intelligence, opportunity tracking and coordinated BD support. Based in Nairobi, the Officer will connect the Somalia Country Office with Nairobi-based donors and partners and support high-quality pre-positioning and bid processes.

**Your main duties and responsibilities will be:**

- **Donor engagement and networks:** Maintain and expand working relationships with donors, embassies, UN agencies, international financial institutions and other financing partners relevant to Somalia, particularly those based in Nairobi.
- **Donor outreach and positioning:** Arrange and support donor meetings, visits and briefings; prepare tailored talking points, capability statements, donor profiles and follow-up actions alongside Somalia colleagues.
- **Funding intelligence:** Monitor donor strategies, calls for proposals, procurement notices and funding trends; identify and share timely leads aligned with DRC Somalia’s priorities.
- **Pipeline and capture management:** Keep the Somalia funding pipeline, donor contacts, opportunity calendars and capture notes current; flag deadlines, gaps and next steps to the Country Office.
- **Opportunity assessment:** Support initial opportunity screening, competitor and partner mapping, and go/no-go inputs in close collaboration with programme, finance and grants colleagues.
- **Bid coordination:** Support the preparation of expressions of interest, concept notes and proposals by organising internal inputs, timelines, donor requirements and partner contributions; draft concise business development materials as requested.
- **Strategic partnerships:** Identify prospective Somali and international civil society organisations, private-sector firms and other consortium partners; support introductory discussions and pre-positioning with relevant colleagues.
- **Commercial opportunities/service contracts:** Track relevant service contracts and tenders; assist with early market research, bid preparation and partner coordination, working with DRC’s Commercial Contracts Team as appropriate.
- **Internal coordination and learning:** Work closely with Somalia Country Office and EAGL Hub and HQ BD and PAER teams, share donor intelligence, capture lessons and provide regular updates on outreach and pipeline progress.

***About you***

To be successful in this role we expect you to have:

***Required***

- At least 3 years of relevant experience in BD, donor engagement, fundraising, partnerships or proposal support in the humanitarian, development or displacement sector.
- Bachelor’s degree in international development, international relations, economics, social sciences, business administration or another relevant discipline
- Established professional networks and experience engaging institutional donors and/or donor missions relevant to Somalia, particularly those represented in Nairobi.
- Good understanding of donor funding cycles, partnership development and the preparation of expressions of interest, concept notes or proposals.
- Strong interpersonal, networking and representation skills, with the confidence to approach donors and follow through on relationships.
- Excellent written communication, analysis, organisational skills and attention to deadlines; ability to synthesise technical programme information for donor audiences.
- Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with country teams and regional colleagues across different locations.
- Knowledge of the Somalia aid context and DRC Somalia’s thematic work—including protection, economic recovery and livelihoods, durable solutions, emergency response, shelter/WASH and resilience—is an advantage.
- Previous experience with commercial contracts, competitive tenders or consultancy/service procurement is an advantage.
- English: full professional fluency, written and spoken (required).Somali: an advantage.

***In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’ five core competencies:***

**Striving for excellence:** You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process.

**Collaborating:** You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback.

**Taking the lead:** You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation.

**Communicating:** You listen and speak effectively and honestly.

**Demonstrating integrity:** You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

**We offer**

**Contract length:** 12 months

**Band:** Non-Management H1

**Designation of Duty station**: Kenya-Somalia Program

**Reporting Line:** Head of Programmes, Somalia

**Start Date:** December 2026

This position is open to National Candidates. The relevant terms and conditions of employment will apply.
**Application process**

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. **Applications sent by email will not be considered.**

Closing date for applications: **10th December 2026**

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website [drc.ngo](https://drc.ngo/).

*Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.*

jobs.title: Project Manager - Ukraine
jobs.description:
INTERSOS is an independent humanitarian organisation that assists the victims of natural disasters, armed conflicts and exclusion. Its activities are based on the principles of solidarity, justice, human dignity, equality of rights and opportunities, respect for diversity and coexistence, paying special attention to the most vulnerable people.

## **TERMS OF REFERENCE**

- **Job Title:** Project Manager
- **Code:** SR-60-10353
- **Duty station:** Location to be confirmed once the project is approved: Odesa or Mykolaiv
- **Starting date:** 01/02/2027
- **Contract duration:** 12 months
- **Reporting to:** Head of Programme
- **Supervision of:** Project staff
- **Type of Duty Station:** Non-family duty station

## **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF THE CONTEXT**

The war in Ukraine, which started on the 24th of February 2022, shows no signs of abating, and continues to drive increasing humanitarian needs across the country. Access concerns and humanitarian needs are particularly high in eastern Kharkivska, Sumska oblasts and south Khersonska oblast where the conflict is intensifying and critical infrastructure damages prevent civilians from accessing basic services.

Today INTERSOS is present in Odeska, Mykolaivska, Khersonska and Kharkivska Oblasts with bases of operations in Kharkiv, Kherson, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Kiev allowing a wide geographical coverage. Moreover, INTERSOS is currently implementing Health, Protection, and NFIs interventions, funded by OCHA, AICS, GFFO and ECHO encompassing several components: distribution of medicines to Regional Health Departments and shelters and equipment for clinics, Cash for Health, mobilisation of Protection mobile teams, establishment of community-based protection mechanisms, case management for CP/PWSN cases, psychosocial support (PSS), Protection Monitoring (PM), and distribution of material assistance to vulnerable individuals and households.

## **GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE POSITION**

The Project Manager ensures constant engagement by/with different support departments to ensure timely support to the project team.

The Project Manager is budget holder for the whole project grant/budget and supervises/monitors closely the financial planning, liquidity planning and budget utilization/burn rate monitoring.

The financial/budget management is the final responsibility of the Project Manager for the specific project and he/she must ensure that this goes together with close log frame and work plan monitoring.

## **MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS**

**Main responsibilities**

- Ensures the planning, implementation and monitoring/evaluation and sets targets as included in the project description. Flag significant deviation from the program implementation plan and estimated expenditures; alert relevant staff.
- Guarantee an efficient financial management as main budget holder for the project in compliance with INTERSOS’ model and donor regulations.
- Team/HR management (staff and volunteers)
- Deliver quality project activities reporting, including the findings in terms of impact/changes at the level of beneficiaries achieved through the project, compliant and consistent reporting per INTERSOS and donor requirements, in collaboration with the HQ Grants Unit
- Develop clear understanding of INTERSOS program and country strategy among project team – ensure also timely input/feedback by team on strategic issues.
- Support the Head of Programme in program/project development.
- Ensure that program delivery matches INTERSOS and donor technical minimum standards and seek technical section and MEAL department guidance and tools.
- Ensure clear overview of actors and services in area of intervention, permitting development and implementation of partnerships and referral pathways.
- Administrative and office support activities (agreement, amendments, signed reports, communications, etc.), ensuring documentation cycle is up to date, and ensure all departments’ requirements are aligned and addressed.

**Detailed responsibilities and tasks**

- Ensure the full and timely implementation of the project proposal as approved, pro-actively respecting deadlines for reporting:
- Project kick-off and presentation/sharing of project with teams
- Review and prepare a detailed activity plan with team
- Verification on the targeting of beneficiaries

**Financial management and procurement**

- Prepare, monitor and implement financial and procurement plan
- Prepare financial plan
- Approval of all purchases/contracting and budget line allocations
- Verify the bookkeeping entries in the INTERSOS accounting spread sheets (JOURNAL): verify budget line allocations, budget expenditure status against actual delivery and the financial plan for the remainder project implementation period
- Ensure for all purchases/contracting of goods/services/supplies the correct INTERSOS procurement guidelines are applied and properly documented, in coordination with the Finance and Logistics departments.
- Verify the list of expenditures prior to finalizing the interim and final financial reports
- Holds final responsibility for verification of all support documents’ completeness and correctness.

**People management**

- Agree and establish clear reporting and communication lines
- Team recruitment, liaise with HR Department to secure up to date HR files.
- Permanent on-job coaching of teams to work on quality in delivery.
- Manages and evaluates the performance of the project staff.
- Conduct weekly and monthly meetings with the team to review the planning and discuss the main concerns to focus on for the upcoming period.
- Continuous/fast verification of data quality collected and received from field staff.
- Ensure teams respect INTERSOS rules and guidelines to the mission and adhere to INTERSOS Code of Conduct and Charter of Values.

**Monitoring & evaluation**

- Ensure monitoring and verification for the targeting of beneficiaries.
- Applying a result-based management approach, monitor the project outcomes, in addition to the outputs and activities, including changes at the household and community level achieved through the project.
- Undertake (if security situation allows) field visits to provide technical guidance and supervision to the team and to monitor the progress and quality of the different project activities.

**Reporting**

- Ensure quality reporting on achievements through daily short briefings, monthly and weekly planning presented against weekly and monthly performance reports containing clear quantitative and qualitative information related to the activities.
- Secure regular reporting per team and compile, review and analyses reports on monthly bases to be reflected in INTERSOS Project Appraisal Tool.
- Prepare ad hoc progress reporting for the donor and official required interim and final project reports; prepare interim and final narrative reports for the donor in a timely and qualitative manner, looking into achievements against outcomes and output and reflect lessons learnt clearly into recommendations for future programming.
- Holds final responsibility for all support documents (means of verification) and general project documents.
- Delivers regular communication products (including pictures) on the project to be used by the INTERSOS communication department in different outlet.
- **Coordination and representation**
- Support the Head of Programme / Technical Coordinators in attending cluster meetings and ensure timely reporting of highlights and relevant information for intervention area.
- Participate in regular meetings with the donor representatives and facilitates field visits by donor missions (when security allows for), in coordination with the Program Coordinator.
- Ensure systematic information and update sharing with the program coordinator
- Perform any other related duties as required.

## **REQUIRED PROFILE AND EXPERIENCE**

### **Education**

- Advanced university degree in Social Sciences, Political Sciences, International Relations, Humanitarian and International Cooperation or related field

## Professional experience

- Minimum 3 years of professional experience in management of humanitarian project/program, including financial management and logistics responsibilities
- Minimum 1 year experience in the implementation of multi-sector humanitarian programming and in security context analysis
- Experience managing health programs will be considered an asset
- Experience in establishing and maintaining collaborative relationships with donors and government counterparts, and with donors compliance and reporting
- Experience in complex emergency settings

### **Professional requirements**

- Strong representation and negotiation skills
- Administration, finance and budget management skills
- Essential computer literacy (word, excel and internet)
- Analytical thinking, analysis capacity and strategic program development skills

### **Languages**

- Fluent English (written and spoken) is compulsory.
- Knowledge of Italian is preferential
- Ukrainian or Russian language will be additional value

### **Personal requirements**

- Ability to ensure quick quality delivery in stressful environments
- Ability to adhere to deadlines and respect line management
- Strong interpersonal skills: communication, diplomatic skills
- Leadership, people management and development
- Organization and problem solving
- Commitment to INTERSOS principles

## **GENERAL CONDITIONS AND BENEFITS**

- **Salary range:** 10 - 3.362€ - 3.792€ monthly gross
- **Accommodation:** Shared Guesthouse
- **R&R:** INTERSOS staff required to work for extended periods at duty stations under hazardous, stressful and difficult conditions are granted a regular and mandatory period of Rest and Recuperation (R&R). This is due to protecting their health and well-being and ensuring optimal work performance upon the resumption of their duties, while, at the same time, preserving the operational readiness of the Organisation. R&R benefits are not financial compensation for the degree of hardship and insecurity of a duty station.
Eligibility: staff members recruited as international field staff whose contract states one R&R Duty Station as the main Duty Station and whose contract duration is equal to or longer than 4 calendar months.
R&R: 7 days of psycho-physical recovery every 8 weeks + 1000€ allowance.
- **Remuneration:** The monthly remuneration is defined, for each position, according to the standard salary grid and function grid, taking into account the experience of the selected candidate. It is communicated during the HR interview, or at any rate during the first stage of the selection process.
- **Transportation:** Round-trip flights for the humanitarian. For any mission lasting at least 9 months, an additional flight ticket to the Country of residence and return to the mission is covered by the Organisation for the humanitarian worker.
- **Medical insurance:** Injuries and death insurance; civil liability insurance; reimbursement for vaccines, medical certificate and PCR test for deployment; psychosocial support on request for the humanitarian worker.
- **Visa:** INTERSOS covers the costs and visa support for the humanitarian worker.
- **Annual Leave:** 2.5 days per month
- **Installation costs:**\[insert here (if applicable\]
- **School fees:** \[insert here (if applicable\]
- **Induction:** Online orientation course: each new staff member receives preparatory training before departure, adequate to provide the necessary information related to the structure of INTERSOS and the main decision-making processes and working tools, in order to facilitate entry into the Organisation.
- **Note 1:** INTERSOS applies a “Learning & Development Policy” which includes the possibility to receive capacitation and participate in internal and external training. Priority will be given to the staff working for INTERSOS for over two years.
- **Note 2:** The categorisation of Accompanied, RnR, and Unaccompanied Duty stations is subject to security criteria, access to health and education services, and is non-negotiable.
